models.validation.enabled: Enabled must be y or n.
models.validation.secret: A field value looks like secret/key material and cannot be saved (value hidden). Model fields store names, never keys.

models.form.approval.update: Updates model {{id}} in provider {{provider}}. Key values are untouched.

presets.editor.discard.title: Discard Changes?
presets.overwrite.title: Overwrite Preset?
presets.editor.validation.name: Preset name must not be empty.

presets.editor.validation.tools: tools must be a comma list of read,search,write,exec.

presets.editor.validation.key_env: search_key_env must be an environment variable NAME, not a key value.

prompts.screen.title: Prompt Library
prompts.editor.title: Prompt Editor
prompts.editor.hint: Multi-line editing. The text shown is the effective prompt for this slot.
prompts.reset.title: Reset to default?
prompts.reset.body: Restore {{slot}} to the compiled default text?
prompts.empty: All prompt slots use compiled defaults.
prompts.status.count: {{active}} of {{total}} slots have an active override.
prompts.editor.default_view: No override file exists. The text below is the compiled default, shown as a read-only reference. Saving writes a new override file.
prompts.editor.guardrail.seat: The compiled seat preamble is anti-nesting control text for native seats. Editing it changes native seat behavior in every fanout run.
prompts.editor.save.title: Save prompt?
prompts.editor.save.body: Write {{path}} ({{bytes}} bytes) and make it the active override?
prompts.editor.env_note: Note: env AGY_PRO_SEAT_PREAMBLE is set and still wins over the file layer.
prompts.editor.cred.warn: Warning: the buffer looks like secret or key material (content hidden). Prompt files are plain text.
prompts.editor.cred.title: Save secret-looking text?
prompts.editor.cred.body: The buffer matches credential shapes (a key prefix or a long opaque token). Prompt files are plain text. Save it anyway? The buffer content is never logged.
prompts.editor.reset.none: No override file exists for this slot.
prompts.editor.reset.done: Override file deleted: {{path}}. The compiled default is back in force.
prompts.editor.discard.title: Discard unsaved edits?
prompts.editor.discard.body: The edits on this prompt are dropped and nothing is written.
settings.screen.title: Settings
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.prompt.delete_name: Provider name to delete (registry entry only)
settings.prompt.hint: Ctrl+S submits - Tab moves to OK - Esc cancels
settings.msg.wizard: Interactive wizard: run `agy pro setup` (or `agy pro settings providers add-interactive`). Raw key echo is masked first-5 + ****.
settings.msg.presets_none: (no saved presets; p1/p2/p3 defaults always available)
settings.result.hint: Arrows and PgUp/PgDn scroll. Esc returns.
settings.approval.replace: Replace provider {{name}} wholesale: the current entry and its whole model list are discarded.
settings.approval.rename: Rename provider {{old}} to {{new}}; the model list carries over unchanged.
settings.approval.fix_keys: Repair BOM-variant key names for {{target}}; an entry is rewritten only when its clean name probes dead and a BOM variant probes valid.
settings.approval.fix_keys_write: A DPAPI-encrypted backup of every touched value is written (0600, atomic) before any change; providers.json is not modified.
settings.approval.rollback: Restore registry key names from backup {{dir}}; entries recorded as absent are deleted, the rest are rewritten.
settings.approval.rollback_write: No file is written; the user environment store is mutated in place.
doctor.screen.title: Doctor / Status
doctor.scroll_hint: Arrows and PgUp/PgDn scroll. This screen is read-only.
doctor.fix.hint: This screen is read-only. To repair key names, run in your terminal:
doctor.fix.keys_cmd: agy pro settings doctor fix-keys all
help.screen.title: Help
help.keys.arrows: Arrows move the cursor, Enter activates
help.rtl.title: Right-to-Left (Arabic) Scope
help.rtl.note: Arabic ships in logical order with mirrored layout: right-aligned text, right-side gutters, reversed footer. Not promised: visual bidi reordering on conhost or Windows Terminal, Arabic shaping, mid-string truncation of Arabic, inline RTL cursor editing.
help.keys.rows_past_9: Rows past 9: arrows + Enter reach them
help.keys.page: Scrolls one page up or down
help.keys.home_end: Jumps to the first or last row
help.keys.save: Edit mode: save binding in editors
help.keys.runes: Edit mode: printable runes become text input
help.numbered.reminder: Every list numbers its rows: digits 1-9 select and activate, arrows move the cursor, Enter activates.
help.storage.providers.purpose: provider registry; every write goes through the approval modal
help.storage.state.purpose: profile mode, default profile, language, launcher toggle
help.storage.prompts.purpose: custom system prompts, one file per slot
help.color.title: Color Tier
help.color.note: Detected once at startup: a non-console output or NO_COLOR forces plain, a VT probe gates color at all, then WT_SESSION or COLORTERM=truecolor picks truecolor and every other console gets 256 colors. Set AGY_PRO_COLOR to truecolor, 256, 16, or off to force a tier.
help.close_hint: PgUp/PgDn/Home/End scroll; any other key closes this overlay.

view.default_profile.label: Default Launch Profile
view.default_profile.note: prompt = fast launcher on plain agy; native = straight to native Gemini; gateway = local LLM bridge
view.current_mode.label: Profile Mode
view.current_mode.note: full = orchestrator rules + agent skills/plugins; clean = minimal baseline. Switching backs up the config dir first.
view.managed_items.label: Managed Items (profile switch set)
view.managed_items.note: moved to a timestamped backup on every mode switch; never deleted
view.last_backup.label: Last Profile Backup
view.updated_at.label: State Updated At
view.config.show.label: Config Read View
view.config.show.note: same content as `agy pro config show`; this panel is the settings view
view.mode.switch.label: Switch Profile Mode
view.mode.restore.label: Restore Latest Profile Backup
view.mode.backups.label: List Profile Backups
view.mode.backups.note: numbered backup listing (`agy pro mode list`)
view.mode.status.label: Profile Mode Status
view.env.AGY_LAUNCHER.label: AGY_LAUNCHER=0 (skip launcher)
view.env.AGY_LAUNCHER.note: when set to 0 the fast launcher is bypassed (decide.go)
view.providers.list.label: List Providers
view.providers.list.note: providers + model capabilities (`agy pro status`, `agy pro models`)
view.providers.add_interactive.label: Add/Update Provider (interactive wizard)
view.providers.add_interactive.note: the ONLY secret-entry path: raw key input echo is masked first-5 + **** (§2.11)
view.providers.add_json.label: Add/Update Provider (non-interactive)
view.providers.add_json.note: APIKeyEnv = environment-variable NAME only; a key VALUE is rejected (F-PROV)
view.providers.test.label: Test Provider (live probe)
view.providers.test.note: probe via the AuditKeys path (5s, masked)
view.providers.rename.label: Rename Provider
view.providers.rename.note: registry-entry rename only; key material untouched (F-PROV)
view.providers.delete.label: Delete Provider
view.providers.delete.note: registry-entry removal ONLY - never touches env/registry key values, never deletes files (F-PROV)
view.models.inventory.label: Combined Model Inventory
view.models.inventory.note: run `agy pro models --all` for the numbered combined view (contract §2.5)
view.providers.presets.label: Provider Presets (catalog)
view.providers.presets.note: built-in base URL + key env defaults; charm is a user-registered custom provider (F-PRESET)
view.providers.model_capabilities.label: Model Capability Fields
view.providers.model_capabilities.note: defaults: context 1048576, maxOut 131072, tools read_file,list_dir,grep,glob, reasoning default
view.providers.key_policy.label: Registry Key Policy
view.providers.key_policy.note: providers.json is written 0600 atomic; display values use first-5 + **** masking
view.providers.registry_error.label: Registry Load Error
view.provider.key.label: Key status - {{name}}
view.provider.key.note: resolved from process env then persistent stores; values never shown beyond the mask
view.bridge_tools.label: Bridge Tools Allow-List
view.bridge_tools.note: capability tokens read,search,write,exec or none; AGY_PRO_BRIDGE_TOOLS overrides the stored value at run time
view.env.AGY_PRO_BRIDGE_TOOLS.label: AGY_PRO_BRIDGE_TOOLS Override
view.env.AGY_PRO_BRIDGE_TOOLS.note: precedence: env > stored state > default read,search
view.budget.iterations.label: Budget: Iterations per Request
view.budget.wall.label: Budget: Wall Clock per Loop
view.budget.turn.label: Budget: Per Upstream Turn
view.budget.tool.label: Budget: Per Tool Execution
view.budget.tool_calls_per_turn.label: Budget: Tool Calls per Turn
view.budget.fallback.label: Budget: Fallback on Exhaustion
view.native_seat_concurrency.label: Native Seat Concurrency
view.native_seat_concurrency.note: cap on simultaneous native (real-agy) fanout seats; clamped 1..8 (contract §2.3)
view.fanout.n.label: Fanout Default Seats (--n)
view.fanout.n.note: CLI flag truth (fanout/cli.go); flags remain the power-user/CI path
view.fanout.timeout.label: Fanout Wall Timeout (--timeout)
view.fanout.timeout.note: CLI flag truth (fanout/cli.go); the shared provider client's per-request timeout is derived from this budget (never shorter, 120s floor)
view.fanout.max_turns.label: Fanout Max Turns (--max-turns)
view.fanout.tools.label: Fanout Tools (--tools)
view.fanout.tools.note: CLI flag truth; closed set read,search,write,exec
view.fanout.task.label: Fanout Task (--task)
view.fanout.flags.label: Fanout Other Flags
view.fanout.flags.note: CLI truths surfaced here so nothing is reachable only via flags (D2)
view.fanout.registry_defaults.label: Registry Defaults Block
view.fanout.registry_defaults.note: D4: consumed as the rung below presets (CLI flag > preset via flag/AGY_PRO_FANOUT_PRESET/default key > providers.json defaults > engine default); read-only, written only via the M4 approval modal; drift from engine defaults is surfaced per run
view.fanout.consensus.label: Reconciliation Consensus
view.fanout.failover.label: Failover Policy
view.fanout.failover.note: k3 family is excluded from AUTO-seating (pool policy)
view.swarm.k3_exclusion.label: k3 Pool Exclusion
view.swarm.k3_exclusion.note: explicit --models/--seats picks are exempt; rotation and failover skip k3 (§2.5b)
view.swarm.templates.label: Swarm Templates
view.swarm.presets.label: Saved Seat Presets (p1/p2/p3 + user)
view.swarm.presets.note: numbered selection text (e.g. 1,3,19,23) stored in ~/.agy-pro/swarm-state.json; defaults p1/p2/p3 resolve against the live inventory
view.swarm.save_preset.label: Save Seat Preset
view.swarm.save_preset.note: stores a numbered seat selection via swarm.Store
view.doctor.diagnose.label: Run Doctor
view.doctor.diagnose.note: real agy binary, shim PATH location, state/dirs, provider-key probes (masked); --strict gates structural failures only
view.doctor.fix_keys.label: Repair Key Names (--fix-keys)
view.doctor.fix_keys.note: BOM-variant key-name repair; writes a backup and prints the rollback dir
view.doctor.rollback_keys.label: Rollback Key Repair
view.doctor.rollback_keys.note: restores registry key names from the backup written by fix-keys
view.doctor.exit_semantics.label: Doctor Exit Semantics
view.doctor.exit_semantics.note: key-probe verdicts are informational (N-3) and never gate the exit code
view.version.info.label: Shim Version
view.version.info.note: agy-pro Go shim & swarm orchestrator (`agy pro version`)
view.version.shim_path.label: Shim Path
view.version.real_agy.label: Real agy Path
view.version.real_agy.note: authentic Antigravity CLI resolved from AGY_PRO_REAL_AGY / PATH
view.update.info.label: Update
view.update.info.note: update is a real-agy subcommand ("Update CLI"); run it in your terminal - the shim delegates
view.uninstall.info.label: Uninstall
view.uninstall.info.note: recycle-bin only; run `agy pro mode restore` first if profile backups exist (agy-pro/README.md)
view.install.info.label: Install
view.install.info.note: deploys to ~/.agy-pro/bin/agy.exe, prepends PATH, gates on doctor
view.env.AGY_PRO_HOME.label: AGY_PRO_HOME
view.env.AGY_PRO_PROVIDERS.label: AGY_PRO_PROVIDERS
view.env.AGY_PRO_REAL_AGY.label: AGY_PRO_REAL_AGY
view.env.AGY_PRO_REAL_AGY.note: absolute path to the real agy binary
view.env.AGY_PRO_ACTIVE.label: AGY_PRO_ACTIVE
view.env.AGY_PRO_ACTIVE.note: recursion guard: set to 1 in shim-spawned children
view.env.GEMINI_CONFIG_DIR.label: GEMINI_CONFIG_DIR
view.env.GEMINI_CONFIG_DIR.note: overrides the Gemini config directory managed by profile switches
view.env.AGY_PRO_WORKSPACE.label: AGY_PRO_WORKSPACE
view.env.AGY_PRO_WORKSPACE.note: workspace root passed to the bridge tool loop
view.env.AGY_PRO_BRIDGE.label: AGY_PRO_BRIDGE / AGY_BRIDGE (legacy)
view.appearance.language.label: Language
view.appearance.language.note: UI language (closed 12-code set); written via Core.Set language
view.appearance.launcher_menu.label: Launcher menu
view.appearance.launcher_menu.note.env: env wins over the stored toggle; editing the stored toggle has no effect until the env is cleared
